result.summary: The home screen is largely functional. One minor contrast issue was found in the promotional banner where the headline and subtext are washed out against the background.

issues.description: The promotional banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and its subtext are rendered in a very light color on top of a pale mint green background, resulting in noticeably low contrast that makes the text hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color (e.g., deep green) for the headline and subtext so they meet readable contrast ratios against the mint background.
